fullContent:
Kanaka Thailam (Oil) 
 Reference: Bhaishajya Ratnavali, Kshudra Roga 59 – 122/123. Page no. 944. 
 Introduction 
 Kanaka Thailam (Oil) is an Ayurvedic oil used in the treatment of oral diseases and to relieve skin scars and face pigmentation. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Madhuka – Licorice – Glycyrhiza glabra – 768 ml 
 Taila – Sesame oil – 192 ml 
 
 8 gm each of: 
 
 Priyangu – Callicarpa macrophylla 
 Manjishta – Rubia cordifolia 
 Chandana – Pterocarpus santalinus 
 Utpala – Nymphaea Caerulea 
 Nagakeshara – Mesua ferrea 
 
 How to Make? 
 Make a kasahya or decoction of licorice in water then add this decoction into sesame oil. Make a fine powder of rest all ingredients and mix. 
 Indications 
 
 Oral diseases 
 Face pigmentation 
 Dark circles 
 
 How to Use? 
 
 Used for external application only 
 It is used to apply over the face and massage. 
 
 Side Effects 
 There are no side effects with this oil on external application. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
